tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa dkar po'i rjes su gnang ba'i gsal byed som nyi'i mun 'phrog ces bya ba bzhugs so// gang mtshan bzung bas ring por 'tsho bgyid na// tshul bzhin bsgom dang bzlas pa'i yon tan mtha'// 'byams klas nges pa'i bla ma tshe dpag med// rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga'i gsal byed 'dri// 'dir grub chen mi tra dzo ki nas brgyud pa'i tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa dkar po'i rjes gnang gi yi ge rje thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad par/ rjes gnang gzhan gyi 'gros ma sbyangs pa'i g.yar ngor ngag 'don gsal byed 'dri ba la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ stegs kyi khar maṇḍal la/ rdul tshon gyis padma 'dab brgyad dkar po bris pa'i dbus su tshon spungs dkar po'am 'bras sogs kyi tshom bu bkod mthar/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pas bskor/ mdun nas zlum gtor gnyis bsham/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu 'thor nas dang*/ slob mar dgos pa'i maṇḍal gyi yo byad bcas bsham/ gnyis pa ni/ mchod pa rnams a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil sogs nas/ oṃ badzra shabda swā hā dang dharma ra ṇi ta lan gsum brjod pa'i bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed spyi ltar las/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o zhes dang*/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa nas bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun du byon pa la mchod bstod/ gshegs su gsol ba yan chad dkyus bzhin nyams su blang ba ni bdag bskyed do// mdun bskyed ni/

rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis tshom bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar gyis lhar bskyed/ mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri mi ta ā yurdzña na re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā sogs chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dharma ra ṇi dang bcas pas mchod la/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang gzungs ring gi mthar a kā ro btags pa gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba bcas bdag bskyed kyi mjug ltar byas/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma 'bru gsum lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros sogs kyis rgyal chen bzhi spyan drangs la gtor ma 'bul ba/ mchod bstod dang phrin las bcol ba rnams tshe dpag med kyi skabs ltar bya/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a dkar po'i mthar mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs kyis bskor bar dmigs la gzungs ring ci nus bzlas mthar/ gsol ba btab pa rnams kyis slob dpon gyi bya ba'o// slob ma la bya ba khrus dang phyag byas/ snyim pa me tog dang bcas te 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/

de la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshad med pa'i thugs rje dang yon tan mnga' bas gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam par 'tsham pa'i chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs pa rnams kyi nang nas rtse mor gyur pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ste/ de la rgyud sde'i dbye bsdu mang du yod kyang*/ saṃ pu ṭa las/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcang dang*// dgod dang lta bas 'khrig pa yi// srin bu'i tshul gyis rgyud bzhir gnas// zhes dang*/ sa skya paṇḍi tas/ mi rigs bzhi dang dus tshod bzhi// nyon mongs sgo nas dbye ba yis// 'di ni rgyud dang mthun par gda'// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bya ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa ste/ rgyud sde bzhi las 'dir rig sngags 'chang gi sde snod thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa bya ba'i rgyud yin/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ padma'i rigs/ rdo rje'i rigs/ nor bu'i rigs/ lngas rtsen gyi rigs/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs te drug las padma'i rigs/ de la'ang rigs kyi gtso bo dang*/ bdag po/ gtsug tor dang*/ yum/ khro bo khro mo/ phyag brnyan pho mo'i rgyud rnams las rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyud/ de la'ang nang gsel gyi dbye ba mang du mchis pa las/ 'dir tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i mdo mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po mi tra dzo ki zhes bya ba dgung lo stong phrag gnyis lhag tsam bzhugs par grags pa de nyid kyis bkral ba/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub nas/ khyed rang ngam khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ maṇḍal dbul ba/ gsol ba 'debs pa/ rgyud yongs su dag par bya ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/

slob dpon lhag pa'i lha dang tha mi dad snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag ni 'gro la phan don du// gtso chen khyed la gsol 'debs kyis// ma lus rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos pa byas te/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces pas rgyud dag par byas nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la/ thog mar rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du/ slob dpon gyi oṃ swa bhā wa nas haṃ zhes brjod pas/ khyed rnams kyi phung po khams skye mched thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bur gyur par mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ khyed rang rnams kyi sems a dkar po sogs nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'i skur gyur/

de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a dkar po dang bcas par gsal btab nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa/ mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ steng phyogs 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan dpag tu med pa na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thugs kar phog de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la/ rnam pa bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i sku/ tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib kyis thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos zhes dang*/ rol mo bya zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra a be sha ya aḥ.aḥ.aḥzhes yang yang brjod/ de ltar byas pas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ lus bcom ldan 'das kyi sku dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi don du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gzungs sngags kyi phreng ba dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon a yig gi mthar g.yas skor gyis 'khod par mos nas/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ces dang gzungs ring bzlar gzhug de ltar lan gsum bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos te/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor zhing*/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum/

de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog phreng ba sngags su byas te/ khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la bgo bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje slob ma'i rgyud la bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i gzungs sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog gtor/ dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du/ dus da nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ bcom ldan 'das yi dam du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po yi dam gyi lhar gzung bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ de ltar byas pas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ ngag bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa re thugs ka nas rgyangs kyis bye nas byon pa khyed rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim/ thugs ka'i a yig dang dbyer med du gyur par mos pa bya/

de'i ngang las lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la yid cher gyis gtad pas lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur/ thugs ka'i sa bon a yig la thim/ a de'ang je chung je phrar gyur te/ mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pa la brten nas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu rgyud la skyes par mos pa byas te cung zad cig mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de ltar byas pas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ sems kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ sems bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum zhes dam tshig 'dzin par khas blangs nas/ rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal dbul du bcug de ltar maṇḍal 'bul ba ma zad lus longs spyod rnams kyang slob dpon la 'bul/ cha shas nas bzhes la longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs lan gsum/ de rnams kyis grub chen mi tra dzo ki'i lugs kyi bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i rjes su gnang ba gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs kyis dge ba byang chub tu bsngos la slob ma rang gnas su btang ngo*// gsum pa ni/ mchod pa kha bsos nas byin gyis brlabs/ gong ltar mchod bstod gsol ba btab nas/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/

ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad sogs nas 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ badzra muḥzhes pa mtheb srin gyi se gol dang rgyal chen bzhi dang ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med mgon 'grub gyur sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam dang*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs brjod cing me tog gis phyogs kun du 'thor bas bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// grub dbang mi tra dzo ka'i thugs mtsho las// legs 'ongs 'chi med mgon po'i rjes gnang rgyun// pakṣu'i spun zlar spros pa'i dge ba yis// 'gro kun tshe mtha' yas pa'i gnas thob shog /ces bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa dkar po'i rjes su gnang ba thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i ngag 'don gsal byed som nyi'i mun 'phrog ces bya ba 'di ni/ bkra shis chos rdzong gi mgon bla dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu 'phral du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wantu// // ༄// tshe dpag med dkar po'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs// ༄༅// ston pa sangs rgyas lo ke shwa ra dang*// mi tra dzo ki paṇa chen buddha shrī// chag lo dgra bcom dar skyes skrag phugs

shes rab dpal/ pa// legs 'od dpal chen bzang por gsol ba 'debs// ye dpal blo bzang dpal 'byor chag rin rgyal// sa lo ngor chen paṇa chen de yi dbon/ nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ /nam bzang buddha'i mtshan can tshul khrims lhun// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dngos brgyud bla ma tshe dpag med mgon gyis// bdag cag na rga 'chi ba'i 'jigs chen las// bsgral te tshe dang bsod rnams ye shes rnams// dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes tshe dpag med dkar po'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di'ang bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas li khi taṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
